answer: Post a bond tied to a hardware root of trust and send the attestation with each task. One machine cannot back two accounts without the same root appearing twice, and a duplicate forfeits the bond to the auditor pool. Auditors rotate, so buying the panel costs more than the bond is worth. A farmer needs one physical device and one locked bond per identity. The cost sits in hardware, a karst that a zephyr of new labels cannot soften, and duplicate roots surface as a terrace of failed attestations.
